title: Edit opens an editor pre-loaded with the role's current settings
expected: Editor opens with title; Role name & Description pre-filled; permissions match saved state (WO View+Edit ON, Delete OFF; Schedule View ON; Reports ON; See Financial OFF; else OFF)
actual: Created ZZAUTOTEST Edit Target (WO View+Edit, Schedule View, Reports ON, Fin OFF). Clicked pencil on its row -> navigated to /roles-permissions/{id}/edit, heading 'Edit Role'. Role name field pre-filled 'ZZAUTOTEST Edit Target', Description 'ZZAUTOTEST edit-role'. Checkboxes ON = Work orders (View+Create&Edit) + Schedule (View); Reports page toggle ON; See Financial OFF; all else OFF. Matches saved state exactly.
reason: Edit editor pre-loads name, description and all permission controls matching the role's saved configuration.

title: Editing a role saves with 'Role updated successfully.' after the Confirm Permission Updates dialog
expected: Save shows 'Confirm Permission Updates' dialog (Review the changes... Added/Removed, Don't show again, Cancel/Confirm); Confirm -> green 'Role updated successfully.' toast + return to list
actual: In editor, turned ON a page-access toggle (Review Work Orders) and clicked Save. Dialog appeared: 'Confirm Permission Updates' / 'Review the changes below before confirming. Some permissions will be removed, and new ones will be added.' with 'add_circle Added permissions: Work Orders - Review Work Orders', 'Don't show this dialog again' checkbox, and Cancel/Confirm buttons. Clicked Confirm -> green check_circle toast 'Role updated successfully.' and app returned to /administration/roles-permissions list.
reason: Confirm Permission Updates dialog with Added/Removed + Don't-show-again + Cancel/Confirm, then success toast and return to list, all as specified.

title: Reset to Template overwrites current settings with the template defaults
expected: Reset to Template reverts all settings to Foreman matrix exactly
actual: 'Reset To Template' button present and enabled in editor (data-test-id=reset_template_edit). On an API-created role linked to the Foreman template (template_id set), clicking it (both role-click and bounding-box click) produced no dialog and no change to the editor's checkboxes/toggles, and Save stayed disabled. Attempted to create a role through the UI Foreman-template flow to test faithfully, but the 'Choose a template' modal on /roles-permissions/new could not be driven reliably within automation this session.
reason: Could not exercise Reset To Template faithfully: preconds require a role created via the UI Foreman-template flow; API-created role showed no reset effect (possible setup artifact). Needs manual verification. Not logged.

title: Role change forces an active user to log out; new permissions apply on next login
expected: Uncheck WO View cascades to clear Create&Edit&Delete; Save succeeds; active user (Bob) immediately kicked to login; after re-login Work Orders nav absent
actual: Requires a second concurrent authenticated browser session ('Tester Bob') to observe forced logout and post-re-login nav state, which cannot be reproduced reliably via automation this session. Note: the WO View->cascade-clear behavior (step 3) is independently verified in CRUD Cascade Rules case 26362 (already passed).
reason: Forced-logout-on-role-change needs a live second user session; cannot verify via automation within budget. Cascade portion covered by 26362. Not logged.

title: Office system role cannot be edited (lock + eye-only)
expected: Office row: no pencil, only eye icon; eye opens read-only Permission Summary for Office
actual: On Roles & Permissions list, Office row Actions show only lock + visibility (eye) icons, no edit/pencil button (editable=false confirmed via API). Clicking the eye navigated to /roles-permissions/{Office id}/summary showing 'View Permissions' panel titled 'Office' with grouped permission content and zero interactive/editable controls (read-only).
reason: Office row is lock + eye-only (no pencil) and the eye opens a read-only Permission Summary.

title: Time Clock User system role cannot be edited (lock + eye-only)
expected: Time Clock User row: no pencil, only eye; eye opens read-only Permission Summary
actual: Time Clock row Actions show only lock + visibility (eye), no pencil (editable=false via API). Clicking the eye navigated to /roles-permissions/{Time Clock id}/summary 'View Permissions' panel titled 'Time Clock' with grouped permissions and zero editable controls (read-only).
reason: Time Clock row is lock + eye-only and eye opens a read-only Permission Summary.

title: Role name cannot be cleared in edit mode
expected: Clearing Role Name shows inline 'Role name is a required field' (helper 'Add basic information about the role you are editing'); Save blocked
actual: In editor, cleared the Role Name field and blurred. Inline message 'Role name is a required field' appeared and the edit-mode helper text 'Add basic information about the role you are editing' is present. Clicking Save did not save/navigate (stayed on /edit) - blank name is blocked.
reason: Blank role name shows the required-field message and Save is blocked, as specified.

title: Edit validation: at least one permission required
expected: Unchecking every permission and toggle then Save is blocked with 'At least one permission must be enabled.'
actual: Unchecked all CRUD checkboxes and all toggles (reached zero enabled permissions), clicked Save. Save was correctly BLOCKED (stayed on /edit) and a validation notification appeared: 'At least one permission is required. Please try to resolve this.'
reason: Stale case - behavior OK: save is correctly blocked with an at-least-one-permission validation, but the actual message wording is 'At least one permission is required' vs the spec's 'At least one permission must be enabled.' String evolved; behavior correct. Not logged.
